posts.text: Unexpected finding from a study on ChatGPT's impact on college: "once the COVID-19 disruption is modeled separately, the introduction of ChatGPT had no detectable effect on grades.. course evaluations for subject understanding, interest, and relative workload show no change" arxiv.org/pdf/2607.21534

Cool paper looking at how AIs solve unbounded, complex business problems in many fields by testing how well they can crack the cases we use to teach MBAs:
1) AI already does extremely well across diverse business topics
2) Models are improving rapidly with time
Paper: arxiv.org/abs/2607.16057
